original_test_intent: Prove that the intended OAM/GPU power limit can be changed through a supported OOB or in-band control, is consistently reported across planes, constrains observed power during Max Power Test and is fully restored afterward.
original_method: Discover the live OAM-to-GPU map, supported limit range/units and compatible Redfish/amd-smi controls; capture every original cap and health state, approve one bounded test value and method, apply/verify it per intended scope, execute the referenced Max Power Test under thermal/power monitoring, correlate configured cap with measured behavior, then restore and verify every original value without clearing logs.
manual_activity: The owner approves topology, tool/method, bounded cap and Max Power Test; an operator monitors thermal/power health and restoration; the owner compares configured versus observed behavior and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Actual OAM population and Redfish EnvironmentMetrics schema/ETag semantics
Compatible ROCm/amd-smi version and device-index mapping
Vendor-supported power-limit ranges/units and original per-device values
Approved OOB or in-band method, scope and bounded test value
Max Power Test workload/duration/pass criteria and instrumentation
Maintenance approval, thermal/power aborts and recovery/restore plan
safety_requirements: Treat Redfish PATCH and amd-smi set/reset as state-changing
Use protected credentials/TLS and never assume fixed endpoint/OAM count/value
Capture all original values before any write and preserve logs
Change only approved devices/value and verify each response/identity
Monitor thermal, power, GPU health and workload continuously
Stop on mapping/ETag/write/workload/alarm/cap mismatch or restore failure
Restore and read back every original cap; do not blind-retry writes
agent_execution_scope: Collect topology, tool/schema, limit ranges and per-device baselines
Prepare one bounded method-specific change and Max Power Test evidence plan
After explicit approval apply/verify the cap and run monitored workload
Restore/read back every original value and report cross-plane results
Perform no arbitrary limit/method choice, unapproved write/stress, unsafe recovery or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve map, tool/schema, supported range, method/value and workload criteria
Authorize cap change/stress and monitor abort/recovery
Disposition cap mismatch, health alarm or restore failure and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It performs only insecure OOB GETs and cannot demonstrate set, in-band control/reset, Max Power Test attainment or restoration.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Build a per-device baseline/applied/observed/restored matrix using one owner-approved protected OOB or compatible in-band method, then correlate it with monitored Max Power Test power.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OOB PowerLimitWatts.SetPoint, in-band MAX_POWER/SOCKET_POWER and set/reset, Max Power Test, no bundle and 10/10-minute values remain; eight OAMs and 550 require live approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an identity-bound matrix to prove configuration, readback, workload effect and restoration for each live OAM/GPU under one controlled method.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds discovered topology, supported bounds, protected writes, continuous safety monitoring and atomic restoration evidence without dropping OOB, in-band or workload expectations.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Redfish read alone proves neither that a cap can be changed nor that hardware power obeys it under load.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power-cap writes can degrade performance or trigger thermal/power instability, and a partial all-device loop can leave asymmetric limits.

project_override_considerations: If only one method is supported, the owner must approve it as satisfying the source's either/or criterion and explain cross-plane verification. If Max Power Test is unavailable, execution is BLOCKED rather than inferred from SetPoint readback.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and read-only omission conflict
Approved topology/map, tools/schema, ranges/units, method/value/workload and maintenance record
Per-device original Redfish SetPoint and amd-smi MAX_POWER/SOCKET_POWER plus health
Complete protected PATCH or set output and verified applied cross-plane values
Max Power Test workload, sampled power/cap/thermal/health and pass-criteria comparison
Per-device restored values/health, no-clear/no-secret/no-retry audit and engineer verdict

DeepSeek classifies PARTIAL, performs only OOB reads and omits required writes, in-band set/reset, stress evidence and restoration.

review_improvement: Turns a read-only shortcut into a controlled end-to-end power-cap proof with cross-plane and workload correlation plus verified rollback.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful SetPoint response is configuration evidence, not proof that the physical GPU honors the cap. The source therefore requires correlation between identity-matched OOB SetPoint, in-band MAX_POWER/SOCKET_POWER and measured workload behavior. Bulk all-device writes risk partial asymmetric state, so original values and per-device outcomes must be recorded before progression. Because allowable caps and stress thresholds are platform-specific, the agent cannot choose 550 or own the final verdict.
